limitations: No token re-decoding in this supplemental pass; core analysis already binds tokens/stops.
Automatic program reconstruction only uses supported displayed operations and requires one complete connected tree.
A local arithmetic error can coexist with other trace changes; primary categories are descriptive, not exhaustive causal labels.
Consistent local equations are not evidence of faithfully computing the supplied original expression.
Same48 groups/one training seed; no new independent scientific observations.

manual_review_method.arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic for the original expression and each supported displayed equation; manually inspect unsupported chained equalities.
manual_review_method.classification: One descriptive primary category per failure; overlapping observations and ambiguity retained. This does not infer hidden model computation.
manual_review_method.primary_precedence: An explicitly false displayed equality receives local_arithmetic_error even if an additional program change is visible.
manual_review_method.replay_scope: All 288 C strict scores replayed from stored outputs and stop metadata; raw outputs exactly equal the core analysis records. Token decoding was already checked by core analysis, not repeated here.
